evidence_class: validation-only controller and horizon selection; not final extrapolation

dataset.control_reconstruction: piecewise linear interpolation between observed 10 min records; this is a slow control-input reconstruction, not high-frequency measurement evidence

forecast.between_issue_rule: hold the latest issue-time forecast curve
forecast.node_interpolation: linear in absolute target time from issue value through the six W2 horizons
forecast.beyond_last_horizon_rule: hold the 360 min forecast for the less-than-10 min issuance offset only

success_gate.structural: all three controllers complete the same scenario and forecast issuance set with finite metrics; both MPC variants use OSQP with zero fallback
success_gate.nonuniform_performance: nonuniform must not be declared beneficial unless it repeatably improves over uniform-tail under the same full forecast curve and 30-decision/6 h budget; PID is a common-provider/common-issuance 15 s architecture baseline
success_gate.negative_result: if nonuniform has no stable advantage, retain the uniform-tail result and report W3 as a negative ablation
